lines.text: Many learners say: In Bangkok have many cars.
Better: There are many cars in Bangkok.
Use there is or there are, not have.
There is! There is a park near my house.

data.right: There are many cars in Bangkok.
data.why: Use there is or there are, not have.

native.hook: “มี” ไม่ใช่ have เสมอไป!
native.tip: ไทยใช้ “มี” ทั้ง have และ there is แต่ถ้าบอกว่ามีอะไรอยู่ที่ไหน ใช้ “there is/are”
native.caption: คุณเคยพูดว่า “In Bangkok have many cars.” ไหม? 😅 ภาษาไทยใช้ “มี” ทั้ง have และ there is แต่ภาษาอังกฤษบอกว่ามีอะไรอยู่ที่ไหนต้องใช้ there is หรือ there are: “There are many cars in Bangkok.” ฟังครู Ama แล้วพูดตามนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มในแอป Lexkite
native.comment: เฉลย: “There is” จำไว้ให้ดีนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มฟรีได้ที่นี่: {link}

en.tip: Thai uses one word for have and there is, but English says there is/are for what is in a place
en.caption: Do you say “In Bangkok have many cars”? 😅 Thai uses one word for have and there is, but English says there is or there are for what is in a place. Say “There are many cars in Bangkok”! Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
